# made with 💕 by HRTD (original)

Night scene drawn by `made.js` for ui-kit. Original art and code — not a port of ascii-sharks or ascii-magic-art.

`ascii-sharks.html` starts it with `startMade(canvas)` when the HRTD scene is selected. The words shimmer, the heart drifts, the frame rate is capped, and `prefers-reduced-motion` holds a single frame.
